claims.evidence: Witness report shows a generic used car engine bay/assembly with pulleys, alternator-like unit, hoses, and sensors, but no readable brand/model/engine code or cylinder count confirmation.

risks.risk: Wrong engine family/compatibility (Hyundai vs Kia vs other) and wrong engine code; physical similarity can mislead without engine code/ID.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate/stamping (engine code) and the full label area on the block/head, plus the VIN/engine code cross-check if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used 4-cylinder engine assembly with unknown compatibility; treated as high-risk for fitment.

risks.risk: Cylinder count may be incorrect (4-cylinder claim not verifiable from the provided shots).
risks.proof: A shot showing the engine layout that confirms cylinder count (e.g., visible cylinder bank/cover markings) or the engine code that maps to cylinder count.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not-confirmed cylinder count; worst-case treated as potentially incompatible/incorrect spec.

risks.risk: Engine completeness risk: missing critical components (ECU, wiring harness, starter, alternator, sensors, turbo parts if applicable).
risks.proof: A full inventory photo list laid out (ECU, starter, alternator, wiring harness, intake/exhaust manifolds, sensors/relays) and a photo of the engine from multiple angles showing all major mounts/ports.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as partial/unknown completeness; treated as not guaranteed to be ready-to-install.

risks.risk: Running/health unknown (no compression/leak-down, no fault codes, no evidence it starts).
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine starting and idling (or a compression test sheet/leak-down results) with check-engine status shown.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-tested/unknown condition; treated as potentially needing overhaul.

risks.risk: Timing system and wear items unknown (timing chain/belt, tensioners, water pump, oil pump, seals).
risks.proof: Photos showing timing cover area (or proof of recent service: receipts) and close-ups of belt/chain condition and any service marks.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown wear; worst-case assumes timing/water pump/seals may need replacement.

risks.risk: Damage not visible from the photos (cracks, bent components, internal damage, seized parts).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of critical areas: block/head for cracks, mounting points, oil pan, and any removed covers; plus a short run video or teardown indicators.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with potential hidden damage; no premium for apparent cleanliness.

risks.risk: Packaging/covering may hide issues (plastic wrap over a component could conceal damage or missing parts).
risks.proof: Remove/photograph the wrapped component clearly (or provide a clip showing it uncovered and intact).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially concealed condition; treated as higher uncertainty.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine identification plate/stamping (engine code) on the block/head.
Photo showing engine code + a reference that confirms Hyundai/Kia and cylinder count.
Photos and/or video confirming completeness: ECU, wiring harness, starter, alternator, major sensors/valves, and any turbo/intercooler parts if applicable.
Video of the engine starting and idling (or compression test/leak-down results).
Close-ups of timing area (timing chain/belt, tensioner) and water pump area, plus any service receipts.
Photos of critical inspection points: block/head for cracks, oil pan, mounting points, and any areas currently covered by plastic wrap.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a used car engine assembly, but the seller’s specific claims (Hyundai/Kia and 4-cylinder) and key pricing drivers (exact engine code, completeness, and health) are not verifiable from the provided shots. Proof is needed to price safely.
